_comment: Core storage-offload profile manifest, read by StorageProfileRegistry. Each entry is the class name of a StorageProfile implementation living at includes/cloud_storage/<ClassName>.php. Plugins declare their own profiles under a 'storage_profiles' key in plugin.json (resolved from plugins/<plugin>/includes/<ClassName>.php). The profile's visibility() — not this manifest — is the single source of truth for which store an object belongs to. See specs/cloud_offload_unification.md and docs/cloud_storage.md.
